Three AI rules to protect you: Iwu AI atọ iji chebe gị
AI can sound confident and still be wron: AI nwere ike ịda ụda obi ike ma ka na-ezighị ezi. Lelee ọnụ ahịa, ụbọchị, iwu na nkwupụta ahụike.

Never paste customers' names, numbers or: Ewepụla aha ndị ahịa, nọmba ma ọ bụ nkọwa akaụntụ n'ime ngwaọrụ AI.
AI can state things that sound confident: AI nwere ike ikwu ihe na-ada ụda obi ike mana ọ bụ ụgha. A na-akpọkarị nke a nhụsianya. Lelee eziokwu ọ bụla n'onwe gị.
Use real photos for products. If custome: Jiri ezigbo foto maka ngwaahịa. Ọ bụrụ na ndị ahịa zụrụ n'ihi foto AI, ha ga-enwe nkụda mmụọ ma nwee ike ịkọ gị.
Never paste private customer data into A: Madobe data ndị ahịa nkeonwe n'ime ngwaọrụ AI. Ma kpachara anya maka ngwa AI na-ekwe nkwa nke ga-eme ka ị baa ọgaranya maka ego n'ihu. Ejila ha kekọrịta okwuntughe mgbasa ozi ọha gị.

Avoid the flash. It flattens the subject: Zere ọkụ. Ọ na-agbasa isiokwu ahụ ma na-akpata onyinyo ọjọọ.
Turn on gridlines and place the product: Gbanwuo gridline ma tinye ngwaahịa ahụ n'ahịrị nke atọ. Hichaa azụ azụ, wee gaa nso kama ibugharị.
